related.title: KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克
related.transfer: 可遷移「磁壓與比壓」與「脈衝能量與排熱」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "Pulse energy and heat removal" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of KSTAR Korea Superconducting Tokamak must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦全超導托卡馬克的長脈衝：低混雜波電流驅動、千秒高約束模與主動水冷鎢偏濾器；KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克則以全鈮三錫超導托卡馬克：一億度的意義、線圈峰值磁場與鎢偏濾器的溫差為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on long pulses in a fully superconducting tokamak: lower hybrid current drive, thousand-second high-confinement mode and an actively cooled tungsten divertor; KSTAR Korea Superconducting Tokamak centres on A tokamak with niobium-tin magnets: what a hundred million degrees means, peak field on the coil and temperature difference across a tungsten divertor, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「低混雜波電流驅動」的模型移到KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「安全因子與電漿電流」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Device size and plasma volume" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Lower hybrid current drive" to KSTAR Korea Superconducting Tokamak, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Safety factor and plasma current", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「磁壓與比壓」與「脈衝能量與排熱」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "Pulse energy and heat removal" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of KSTAR Korea Superconducting Tokamak must be respecified.

related.title: 中國環流三號 HL-3 托卡馬克
related.transfer: 可遷移「磁壓與比壓」與「脈衝能量與排熱」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；中國環流三號 HL-3 托卡馬克的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "Pulse energy and heat removal" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of HL-3 (HL-2M) Tokamak must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦全超導托卡馬克的長脈衝：低混雜波電流驅動、千秒高約束模與主動水冷鎢偏濾器；中國環流三號 HL-3 托卡馬克則以中國最大的常規導體托卡馬克：雙億度、高約束模門檻與先進偏濾器位形為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on long pulses in a fully superconducting tokamak: lower hybrid current drive, thousand-second high-confinement mode and an actively cooled tungsten divertor; HL-3 (HL-2M) Tokamak centres on china's largest tokamak with conventional conductors: twin hundred-million-degree temperatures, the high-confinement threshold and advanced divertor configurations, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「低混雜波電流驅動」的模型移到中國環流三號 HL-3 托卡馬克，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「進入高約束模的功率門檻」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Device size and plasma volume" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Lower hybrid current drive" to HL-3 (HL-2M) Tokamak, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The power threshold for high-confinement mode", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「磁壓與比壓」與「脈衝能量與排熱」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；中國環流三號 HL-3 托卡馬克的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "Pulse energy and heat removal" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of HL-3 (HL-2M) Tokamak must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: EAST 東方超環全超導托卡馬克
history.text: 2006 年第一個電漿；2017 年101 秒高約束模；2021 年1,056 秒長脈衝；2023 年403 秒高約束模；2025 年1,066 秒高約束模。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2006: First plasma. 2017: A 101-second high-confinement mode. 2021: A 1,056-second long pulse. 2023: A 403-second high-confinement mode. 2025: A 1,066-second high-confinement mode. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
